description: Set or clear the app platform subdomain - the '<subdomain>.<base domain>' host Fine Structure already serves the app on. Runs the same ownership, format, reserved-name and uniqueness checks as the Studio subdomain field because it calls the same model function. Replacing a subdomain takes effect immediately and creates NO redirect: the previous name stops resolving to this app and is released for anyone to claim. Pass an empty subdomain to clear it. For a domain the user owns, use add_custom_domain instead.

subdomain.description: Subdomain label: 3-32 characters, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, no leading or trailing hyphen, not a reserved platform name. Empty string clears the subdomain.

name: set_app_subdomain
title: Set App Subdomain
